description: This file defines the ExecCommandResolution structure and associated static methods for resolving executable commands and handling shell command parsing within an Apple macOS application. It includes logic for resolving executable paths, parsing shell command segments, and generating display strings.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A structure containing information about a resolved executable command, including the raw command, resolved path, executable name, and current working directory.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main method to resolve a command array and optional raw command string to an ExecCommandResolution object.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves commands for allowlist purposes, handling shell wrappers and command segments.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Generates patterns for commands that should always be allowed.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable path from a raw executable string considering tilde expansion and search paths.

methods.name: resolveShellSegmentExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable for a segment of a shell command.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects patterns for allowing commands, following command dependencies and wrappers.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Detects and unwraps shell multiplexers like busybox or toybox.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Parses the first token of a command string, respecting quoting.

methods.name: tokenizeShellWords
methods.description: Tokenizes a shell command string into arguments, handling quotes and escapes.

methods.name: splitShellCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a shell command chain into individual segments at command delimiters, respecting quotes and escapes.

methods.name: searchPaths
methods.description: Retrieves search paths for executable lookup from environment variables.
